name: agentia-plugin-driftguard
description: Pre-promotion overwrite and regression radar for Copado user stories. Adds `agentia guard preflight`.
author: Jyotika

permissions.files: read: the repository or folders passed as flags; write: a temp folder for org retrievals and the --report file

guard.description: Pre-promotion safety checks for user stories

scripts.demo: node bin/driftguard.js guard preflight --story US-0001234 --base-dir demo/base --story-dir demo/stories/US-0001234 --target-dir demo/uat-org --other-stories demo/stories --report demo/preflight-report.md
scripts.demo:fixed: node bin/driftguard.js guard preflight --story US-0001234 --base-dir demo/uat-org --story-dir demo/resynced/US-0001234 --target-dir demo/uat-org --report demo/preflight-report-fixed.md
